F32 = np.float32
U32 = np.uint32
TWO = FT(2.0)
ONE = FT(1.0)
ZERO = FT(0.0)
BAIL = FT(1e12)
Z32 = F32(0.0)
ONE32 = F32(1.0)

TRAPY = F32(0.1)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def two_sum(a, b):
    s = ld.fadd_rn(a, b)
    bb = ld.fsub_rn(s, a)
    e = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fsub_rn(a, ld.fsub_rn(s, bb)), ld.fsub_rn(b, bb))
    return (s, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def quick_two_sum(a, b):
    s = ld.fadd_rn(a, b)
    e = ld.fsub_rn(b, ld.fsub_rn(s, a))
    return (s, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def two_prod(a, b):
    p = ld.fmul_rn(a, b)
    e = cuda.fma(a, b, -p)
    return (p, e)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def three_sum(a, b, c):
    t1, t2 = two_sum(a, b)
    a, t3 = two_sum(c, t1)
    b, c = two_sum(t2, t3)
    return (a, b, c)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def three_sum2(a, b, c):
    t1, t2 = two_sum(a, b)
    a, t3 = two_sum(c, t1)
    b = ld.fadd_rn(t2, t3)
    return (a, b)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def renorm_branchy(c0, c1, c2, c3, c4):

            else:

    return (s0, s1, s2, s3)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def renorm(c0, c1, c2, c3, c4):
    s0, c4 = quick_two_sum(c3, c4)
    s0, c3 = quick_two_sum(c2, s0)
    s0, c2 = quick_two_sum(c1, s0)
    c0, c1 = quick_two_sum(c0, s0)
    s1, s2 = quick_two_sum(c1, c2)
    s2, s3 = quick_two_sum(s2, c3)
    s3 = ld.fadd_rn(s3, c4)
    return (c0, s1, s2, s3)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_add(a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3):
    s0, t0 = two_sum(a0, b0)
    s1, t1 = two_sum(a1, b1)
    s2, t2 = two_sum(a2, b2)
    s3, t3 = two_sum(a3, b3)
    s1, t0 = two_sum(s1, t0)
    s2, t0, t1 = three_sum(s2, t0, t1)
    s3, t0 = three_sum2(s3, t0, t2)
    t0 = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(t0, t1), t3)
    return renorm(s0, s1, s2, s3, t0)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sub(a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3):
    return w_add(a0, a1, a2, a3, -b0, -b1, -b2, -b3)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul(a0, a1, a2, a3, b0, b1, b2, b3):
    p0, q0 = two_prod(a0, b0)
    p1, q1 = two_prod(a0, b1)
    p2, q2 = two_prod(a1, b0)
    p3, q3 = two_prod(a0, b2)
    p4, q4 = two_prod(a1, b1)
    p5, q5 = two_prod(a2, b0)
    p1, p2, q0 = three_sum(p1, p2, q0)
    p2, q1, q2 = three_sum(p2, q1, q2)
    p3, p4, p5 = three_sum(p3, p4, p5)
    s0, t0 = two_sum(p2, p3)
    s1, t1 = two_sum(q1, p4)
    s2 = ld.fadd_rn(q2, p5)
    s1, t0 = two_sum(s1, t0)
    s2 = ld.fadd_rn(s2, ld.fadd_rn(t0, t1))
    s1 = ld.fadd_rn(s1, ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fmul_rn(a0, b3), ld.fmul_rn(a1, b2)), ld.fmul_rn(a2, b1)), ld.fmul_rn(a3, b0)), q0), q3), q4), q5))
    return renorm(p0, p1, s0, s1, s2)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_sqr(a0, a1, a2, a3):
    p0, q0 = two_prod(a0, a0)
    p1, q1 = two_prod(ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a0), a1)
    p2, q2 = two_prod(ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a0), a2)
    p3, q3 = two_prod(a1, a1)
    p1, q0 = two_sum(q0, p1)
    q0, q1 = two_sum(q0, q1)
    p2, p3 = two_sum(p2, p3)
    s0, t0 = two_sum(q0, p2)
    s1, t1 = two_sum(q1, p3)
    s1, t0 = two_sum(s1, t0)
    t0 = ld.fadd_rn(t0, t1)
    s1, t0 = quick_two_sum(s1, t0)
    p2, t1 = quick_two_sum(s0, s1)
    p3, q0 = quick_two_sum(t1, t0)
    p4 = ld.fmul_rn(ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a0), a3)
    p5 = ld.fmul_rn(ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a1), a2)
    p4, p5 = two_sum(p4, p5)
    q2, q3 = two_sum(q2, q3)
    t0, t1 = two_sum(p4, q2)
    t1 = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(t1, p5), q3)
    p3, p4 = two_sum(p3, t0)
    p4 = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fadd_rn(p4, q0), t1)
    return renorm(p0, p1, p2, p3, p4)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_mul2(a0, a1, a2, a3):
    return (ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a0), ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a1), ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a2), ld.fmul_rn(TWO, a3))


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def w_from(a):
    return (a, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO)


@cuda.jit(device=True, fastmath=False)
def c_mul(ar_0, ar_1, ar_2, ar_3, ai_0, ai_1, ai_2, ai_3, br_0, br_1, br_2, br_3, bi_0, bi_1, bi_2, bi_3):
    xr_0, xr_1, xr_2, xr_3 = w_mul(ar_0, ar_1, ar_2, ar_3, br_0, br_1, br_2, br_3)
    yr_0, yr_1, yr_2, yr_3 = w_mul(ai_0, ai_1, ai_2, ai_3, bi_0, bi_1, bi_2, bi_3)
    rr_0, rr_1, rr_2, rr_3 = w_sub(xr_0, xr_1, xr_2, xr_3, yr_0, yr_1, yr_2, yr_3)
    xi_0, xi_1, xi_2, xi_3 = w_mul(ar_0, ar_1, ar_2, ar_3, bi_0, bi_1, bi_2, bi_3)
    yi_0, yi_1, yi_2, yi_3 = w_mul(ai_0, ai_1, ai_2, ai_3, br_0, br_1, br_2, br_3)
    ri_0, ri_1, ri_2, ri_3 = w_add(xi_0, xi_1, xi_2, xi_3, yi_0, yi_1, yi_2, yi_3)
    return (rr_0, rr_1, rr_2, rr_3, ri_0, ri_1, ri_2, ri_3)


@cuda.jit(fastmath=False)
def k_qf_C(c0r_0, c0r_1, c0r_2, c0r_3, c0i_0, c0i_1, c0i_2, c0i_3, dx, max_iter, row0, out_f, out_u):
    x, y = cuda.grid(2)
    h = out_u.shape[1]
    w = out_u.shape[2]
    yy = y + row0
    if x < w and yy < h:
        ox = FT(x - w // 2)
        oy = FT(h // 2 - yy)
        pr_0, pr_1, pr_2, pr_3 = w_from(ld.fmul_rn(ox, dx))
        pi_0, pi_1, pi_2, pi_3 = w_from(ld.fmul_rn(oy, dx))
        cr_0, cr_1, cr_2, cr_3 = w_add(c0r_0, c0r_1, c0r_2, c0r_3, pr_0, pr_1, pr_2, pr_3)
        ci_0, ci_1, ci_2, ci_3 = w_add(c0i_0, c0i_1, c0i_2, c0i_3, pi_0, pi_1, pi_2, pi_3)
        zr_0, zr_1, zr_2, zr_3 = w_from(ZERO)
        zi_0, zi_1, zi_2, zi_3 = w_from(ZERO)
        dr_0, dr_1, dr_2, dr_3 = w_from(ZERO)
        di_0, di_1, di_2, di_3 = w_from(ZERO)
        one_0, one_1, one_2, one_3 = w_from(ONE)
        trap_d = BIG32
        trap_n = 0
        r2 = ZERO
        n = 0
        while n < max_iter:
            x2_0, x2_1, x2_2, x2_3 = w_sqr(zr_0, zr_1, zr_2, zr_3)
            y2_0, y2_1, y2_2, y2_3 = w_sqr(zi_0, zi_1, zi_2, zi_3)
            r2 = ld.fadd_rn(x2_0, y2_0)
            if r2 > BAIL:
                break
            fzr = F32(zr_0)
            fzi = F32(zi_0)
            tdx = ld.fsub_rn(fzr, TRAPX)
            tdy = ld.fsub_rn(fzi, TRAPY)
            td = ld.fadd_rn(ld.fmul_rn(tdx, tdx), ld.fmul_rn(tdy, tdy))
            if td < trap_d:
                trap_d = td
                trap_n = n
            er_0, er_1, er_2, er_3, ei_0, ei_1, ei_2, ei_3 = c_mul(zr_0, zr_1, zr_2, zr_3, zi_0, zi_1, zi_2, zi_3, dr_0, dr_1, dr_2, dr_3, di_0, di_1, di_2, di_3)
            t2_0, t2_1, t2_2, t2_3 = w_mul2(er_0, er_1, er_2, er_3)
            dr_0, dr_1, dr_2, dr_3 = w_add(t2_0, t2_1, t2_2, t2_3, one_0, one_1, one_2, one_3)
            di_0, di_1, di_2, di_3 = w_mul2(ei_0, ei_1, ei_2, ei_3)
            m_0, m_1, m_2, m_3 = w_mul(zr_0, zr_1, zr_2, zr_3, zi_0, zi_1, zi_2, zi_3)
            m2_0, m2_1, m2_2, m2_3 = w_mul2(m_0, m_1, m_2, m_3)
            q_0, q_1, q_2, q_3 = w_sub(x2_0, x2_1, x2_2, x2_3, y2_0, y2_1, y2_2, y2_3)
            zr_0, zr_1, zr_2, zr_3 = w_add(q_0, q_1, q_2, q_3, cr_0, cr_1, cr_2, cr_3)
            zi_0, zi_1, zi_2, zi_3 = w_add(m2_0, m2_1, m2_2, m2_3, ci_0, ci_1, ci_2, ci_3)
            n += 1
        out_u[0, yy, x] = n
        if n < max_iter:
            fr = F32(r2)
            lz = ld.fmul_rn(HALF32, math.log(fr))
            out_f[0, yy, x] = ld.fsub_rn(ld.fadd_rn(F32(n), ONE32), math.log2(lz))
            dz2 = F32(ld.fadd_rn(ld.fmul_rn(dr_0, dr_0), ld.fmul_rn(di_0, di_0)))
            out_f[1, yy, x] = ld.fmul_rn(math.sqrt(fr), lz) / math.sqrt(dz2)
        out_f[2, yy, x] = trap_d
        out_u[1, yy, x] = trap_n
